answer: Each identity registers one vertex on a public vine and locks an 80 credit bond in its forge. That vertex forwards one signal per epoch, sealed by an operator-only cipher. A registry lists vertex owners for public recount. The k-th fake still needs a fresh vertex, paying 80 locked plus a 20 credit fee, so 1,000 fakes lock 80,000 and pay 20,000, with no sharing discount. A rented vertex fails on cipher signer mismatch, and a second signal per vertex is rejected, burning 40 forge credits. An honest agent runs a vertex, pays one fee, and reclaims its bond after a clean epoch.
